name: Mount Amel Castles
description: Five hilltop fortresses in southern Lebanon's Jabal Amel region make up this group: Beaufort, Tibnin, Chakra, Deir Kifa and Chama'. Built and rebuilt from the Crusader era to the 19th century by Crusader, Mamluk and Ottoman rulers, they once formed a chain of lookouts guarding routes and farmland. Beaufort, perched on a steep cliff, is the best known. The site is on the List in Danger.
